title: Typing a text message
alt: The pixelated screen of a basic mobile phone showing a text message typed in shorthand: It is gr8 2 c u 2nite. TY 4 ur treats.
author: Miss Puzzle
description: When SMS was first introduced during the early 2000's, the limited capabilities of the service (e.g. a limit of 160 characters per message) lead to developments such as SMS jargon, which became common as users adapted to its restrictions.
